item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q001_histone_related_proteins","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, nucleosome core histones H2A, H2B, H3 and H4—and the histone domain of macro-H2A.1—belong to the same family, Nucleosome core histones (a.22.1.1), the strongest relationship listed here. Other probable homologs occupy different families within the Histone-fold superfamily (a.22.1, SUNID 47113): archaeal histones (a.22.1.2); the TBP-associated-factor family (a.22.1.3), which includes TAF histone-fold domains, CHRAC-14/16, NC2 alpha/beta, NF-YB/NF-YC and the histone domain of Son of sevenless; and bacterial histone-fold proteins (a.22.1.4), including Aq_328 and TTHA1479. Sharing this SCOPe superfamily supports probable common ancestry, but the separate families mark greater divergence and do not justify transferring nucleosome assembly, DNA-packaging, transcriptional, or other functions among them.\n\nAll are in the Histone-fold fold (a.22) and All-alpha class (a). In release 2.08, a.22 contains only the a.22.1 superfamily, but conceptually fold-level similarity alone would establish architecture rather than homology, while class membership is much too broad to imply an evolutionary relationship. Histone-related names are also unsafe evidence: linker histone H1/H5 globular domains (a.4.5.13), H-NS “histone-like” proteins (a.155.1.1), and histone-modifying enzymes lie outside a.22.1 and should not be called histone homologs on their names or functions alone. For modeling, a same-family domain is the preferred template; a different-family a.22.1 member may support only the conserved histone-fold domain and requires boundary, sequence/structure, oligomerization and biological evidence before transferring function or assembly. Automated-match nodes should not be chosen as representatives without independent validation.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info — /api/v1/; /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__search_scop — /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=histone&mode=auto&limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=TAF&mode=auto&limit=50","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113/homology","mcp__scope__list_scop_children — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47112/children?limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113/children?limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47114/children?limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47129/children?limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47134/children?limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101318/children?limit=50"]}]}
